def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    path = "data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_Report_Type.csv"

    # File has a title row, then header row.
    df = pd.read_csv(path, header=1)

    # Standardize first two columns to [reportType, numReports]
    df = df.rename(columns={df.columns[0]: "reportType", df.columns[1]: "numReports"})
    df = df[["reportType", "numReports"]]

    # Keep only rows where numReports is a numeric count; drop header repeats/source/blanks.
    num = (
        df["numReports"]
        .astype(str)
        .str.replace(",", "", regex=False)
        .str.strip()
    )
    num = pd.to_numeric(num, errors="coerce")
    out = df.loc[num.notna(), ["reportType"]].copy()
    out["numReports"] = num[num.notna()].astype(int).to_numpy()

    out["reportType"] = out["reportType"].astype(str).str.strip()
    out = out[out["reportType"].ne("")]

    return out

def process(idTheftByType) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = idTheftByType.copy()
    df = df.rename(
        columns={
            'Identity Theft Reports by Type': 'theftType',
            'Unnamed: 1': 'theftSubtype',
            'Unnamed: 2': 'numReports',
            'Unnamed: 3': 'pctDiffFromPrevYear',
        }
    )

    # Drop non-data rows (blank, headers, notes, source)
    df = df.dropna(subset=['theftType', 'theftSubtype', 'numReports'], how='any')
    df = df[~df['theftType'].astype(str).str.strip().isin([
        'Theft Type',
        'Consumers can report multiple types of identity theft. In 2024, 14% of identity theft reports included more than one type of identity theft',
        'Source: Consumer Sentinel Network Data Book 2024, Federal Trade Commission',
    ])]

    for c in ['theftType', 'theftSubtype']:
        df[c] = df[c].astype(str).str.strip()

    # Clean counts like "42,041" -> 42041
    df['numReports'] = (
        df['numReports']
        .astype(str)
        .str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
        .str.strip()
    )
    df = df[pd.to_numeric(df['numReports'], errors='coerce').notna()].copy()
    df['numReports'] = df['numReports'].astype(int)

    return df[['theftType', 'theftSubtype', 'numReports']]
